blocks.note: je/de/E1: one key record to its display text, and a chord's records joined with spaces
A9t: the chord bound to an action in a context, null when shadowed by a later duplicate, undefined when unbound
Ke: whether a later binding repeats the same context and chord
V: chord equality over the key-record array
eLe: one key record equality (alt and meta alias each other)
ma: the display text for an action's chord, the fallback text, and the one-shot fallback event
pt: the key hint component, chord from ma through the z chord hint
y/C/Se: the hint strip, children joined with a dim middle dot
